plan.angle: The live top 10 is printable PDFs on Pinterest, a church permission slip, one clinic vendor's template and a few fill-and-sign editors, and every result stops at a document. This page shows the three jobs a medical waiver does (health disclosure, emergency treatment authorization, risk acknowledgement), then what a PDF cannot do: hold an activity until the waiver is signed or a doctor has cleared a yes answer, keep health answers out of email alerts, and ask for a new signature when a waiver turns one year old.
tab_stories: A church sends 22 mission trip travelers one waiver link each, reads every travel insurance card into fields, and the trip leader sees 3 travelers still unsigned 10 days before departure.

A dive school's health questions hold the first pool session for any student who answers yes until a physician's clearance letter is uploaded, and the instructor gets an email that says only that a waiver needs review.

An IV hydration clinic has each client initial the 4 risk paragraphs the clinic wrote and sign before the appointment, and the front desk sees an unsigned 9:00 a.m. client flagged on the day's schedule.
A riding stable marks every waiver older than 12 months as due and emails each of 9 riders 14 days before their waiver turns one year old.
